test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: DGEC is related to KNLJ in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, NQOM is related to UXVT. To which of the following is ILJH related to, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (7) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

So, 

 
• ‘DGEC’ is written as ‘KNLJ’

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f498407eebaa5e6c1c6e1f1b6f882c03d5c674d469622a358a743956e43d63c.png] 

​And,

 
• 'NQOM' is written as 'UXVT'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1aa0dbf2b7507e67ec7e10e4c741abd6a5fe7312682607a7d112cb6724513395.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘ILJH’ is written as:

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e33fe1fa89bb034315bbbe157840a1a37d09b8cbada7afa5f1783fef9d1fb107.png] 

​Hence, "**PSQO**" is the correct answer.
